name: SMS text messages
needs: text a reminder before an appointment
send a verification code by SMS
my texts aren't being delivered in the US
summary: Sending text messages through a provider's API. The code is easy. The work is registration (in the US, 10DLC brand and campaign approval for business texting), consent, STOP handling, cost per message, and fraud on verification codes.
need_when: Time-sensitive reminders where email is too slow, like appointments and deliveries.
Users ask for texts and agree to get them.
skip_when: Push notifications or email would do. SMS costs money per message and needs consent paperwork.
Login codes only. Authenticator apps or passkeys are cheaper and safer.

ways.title: A messaging API
ways.how: Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, Telnyx and Amazon SNS or End User Messaging send and receive texts over HTTP.
ways.tradeoff: Standard. US texting needs registration before delivery is reliable.

ways.title: A verification API
ways.how: Twilio Verify, Vonage Verify and similar services handle codes, retries and some fraud blocking.
ways.tradeoff: Less to build. Still pay per attempt, and fraud can run up the bill.

ways.title: A notification platform
ways.how: Novu, Knock or Courier route one notification to email, SMS or push based on user preferences.
ways.tradeoff: One API for all channels. You still bring an SMS provider.

prompt:
Add SMS reminders with [provider].

Requirements:
- Collect phone numbers in E.164 format with an explicit, unchecked-by-default consent box that says what we'll text and how often. Store consent time and wording.
- Confirm the number with a one-time code before sending anything else.
- Every first message says who it's from and "Reply STOP to opt out". Handle STOP, START and HELP from the inbound webhook and stop all texts on STOP.
- Send from a background job, respect quiet hours in the user's timezone, and cap messages per user per day.
- Save delivery status callbacks and show failures in the admin.
- Rate limit verification codes per number and per IP, and block number ranges I don't serve, to prevent SMS pumping fraud.
- Keep the provider credentials in secrets, and log message ids, not message bodies with personal data.
- Note what registration I need (US 10DLC brand and campaign) before going live.

Acceptance checks (run each and show me the result):
1. Replying STOP stops all further texts and the app shows the user as opted out.
2. No text goes out between 9 PM and 8 AM in the user's timezone.
3. Hammering the send-code endpoint gets throttled.
4. Delivery failures show up in the admin.
5. Consent time and wording are stored for every number.
acceptance_checks: Replying STOP stops all further texts and the app shows the user as opted out.
No text goes out between 9 PM and 8 AM in the user's timezone.
Hammering the send-code endpoint gets throttled.
Delivery failures show up in the admin.

if_you_skip_it: Carriers filter your texts, you text people who opted out, or bots run up a large bill through your verification form.
